pattern: group by entity, conditional sum and count, single-row share calculation
question: out of all donation rupees collected, what fraction came from donors who contributed on more than one occasion - give percent and the number of such donors
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM("Amount") AS donor_total FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor") SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN donor_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(donor_total) AS repeat_share_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM counts
sql_duckdb: WITH donor_counts AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Donor") AS total_donors, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE donor_multi_occurrence) AS multi_occurrence_donors FROM (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "Donor") AS donor_multi_occurrence FROM "donations") AS sub) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * multi_occurrence_donors / NULLIF(NULLIF(total_donors, 0), 0), 2) AS percent, multi_occurrence_donors AS count FROM donor_counts

out of all donation rupees collected, what fraction came from donors who contributed on more than one occasion - give percent and the number of such donors
attempts.response:
WITH donor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT "Donor") AS total_donors,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE donor_multi_occurrence) AS multi_occurrence_donors
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "Donor",
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "Donor") AS donor_multi_occurrence
    FROM "donations"
  ) sub
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * multi_occurrence_donors / NULLIF(total_donors, 0),
    2
  ) AS percent,
  multi_occurrence_donors AS count
FROM donor_counts;
